channels.name: C_hoogsteen_opening_proxy_kT
channels.description: harmonic cost of reaching a 60 degree base-pair opening
channels.reason: a harmonic proxy: a Watson-Crick to Hoogsteen transition is a roughly 180 degree glycosidic flip into a second free-energy basin, and a single Gaussian has no second basin, so this is the local stiffness against opening rather than a barrier or a population.

channels.name: C_salt_dtwist_deg

channels.reason: cgNA+ ships one parameter set, fit at a single ionic strength and temperature, so a re-predicted geometry under this condition would be the unmodified geometry with a new label on it. The value is NaN rather than a plausible number, and the ABC and hexamer-scale MD libraries PLAN.md names as Family C ground truth are what would supply it.

channels.name: G_cpd_methyl_weighted_W
channels.description: Watson strand dimer propensity with the methylated-cytosine enhancement applied
channels.reason: the dipyrimidine classification is exact, but the propensity weighting across the four classes and the roughly twofold enhancement at methylated cytosine are applied as flat factors from the literature rather than fitted to CPD-seq. The plan's ground truth is CPD-seq and dCPD-seq, and this channel is the structural prior that measurement would correct.

channels.name: E_k_open_per_s
channels.description: base-pair opening rate
channels.reason: an attempt frequency is not derivable from equilibrium thermodynamics. The closing rate is fixed at the 1e7 per second that imino exchange measurements report for both AT and GC pairs, and the opening rate follows from the computed equilibrium constant. The sequence dependence is therefore entirely that of the equilibrium constant, and any sequence dependence of the prefactor itself is absent.
